Zoning By-law Amendment - 417 Wellington Street and 275 Highview Drive
Councillor Wookey advised that he voted in favour of the zoning by-law amendment for 417 Wellington Street and 275 Highview Drive in error and that he does not support the proposed 10 storey building across from the townhouses.

Committee of Adjustment - Minor Variance - 41 Metcalfe Street
Notice of a public meeting to take place by Zoom on November 12th, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. was received from the Committee of Adjustment regarding an application for a minor variance by Kyle and Katrina Spooner to permit an exterior staircase 9.12 metres from the center line of St. Annes Place whereas the minimum required setback to any building or structure is 16 metres at 41 Metcalfe Street.

33.
BY-LAWS
33.a
First Reading
Moved by:
Councillor Herbert
Seconded by:
Councillor Rymal
THAT: Leave be granted to bring in the following by-laws:
1. A by-law to confirm the proceedings of the Council meeting held on the 2nd day of November, 2026.
2. A by-law to authorize the Mayor and Clerk to execute and affix the Seal of the Corporation to a certain agreement between the Corporation of the City of St. Thomas, Pauline Andrea McKenzie and Courtney Andrea Symister (Loan Acknowledgement Agreement - Community Improvement Program - File No. 2026-170 - 98 Benjamin Parkway)
3. A by-law to adopt Official Plan Amendment No. 119 to the City of St. Thomas Official Plan (City Initiated – to ensure that City parkland policies are aligned with the Parks and Recreation Master Plan updates and recommendations - File No.: 3-04-26)
4. A by-law to require the conveyance of land for park or other public recreational purposes within the City of St. Thomas, or the payment of money in lieu of such conveyance (Parkland Dedication By-law - City Initiated)
5. A by-law to assume Municipal Services in respect of Registered Plans between 1998 and 2026. (Subdivision Assumptions)
6. A by-law to authorize the Mayor and Clerk to execute and affix the Seal of the Corporation to a certain amending agreement between the Corporation of the City of St. Thomas and Vianode Canada Inc. (Land Lease - Yarmouth Yards)
Carried.
33.b
Second Reading
Moved by:
Councillor Herbert
Seconded by:
Councillor Rymal
THAT: The by-laws be now read a first time, referred to Council in Committee of the Whole and read a second time.
Carried.
33.c
Third Reading
Councillor Clarke was appointed Chair of Council in Committee of the Whole and conducted the second reading of the by-laws.
On motion duly moved and seconded, the Chair was ordered to report on the passing of the by-laws. The Chair reported as ordered and the Mayor resumed the Chair.
Moved by:
Councillor Herbert
Seconded by:
Councillor Rymal
THAT: The report of Council in Committee of the Whole on the following by-laws be received and adopted, the same be read a third time, engrossed, signed by the Mayor and Clerk, sealed and numbered.
1. A by-law to confirm the proceedings of the Council meeting held on the 2nd day of November, 2026. (B/L 143-2026)
2. A by-law to authorize the Mayor and Clerk to execute and affix the Seal of the Corporation to a certain agreement between the Corporation of the City of St. Thomas, Pauline Andrea McKenzie and Courtney Andrea Symister (Loan Acknowledgement Agreement - Community Improvement Program - File No. 2026-170 - 98 Benjamin Parkway)          (B/L 144-2026) (A/G 65-2026)
3. A by-law to adopt Official Plan Amendment No. 119 to the City of St. Thomas Official Plan (City Initiated – to ensure that City parkland policies are aligned with the Parks and Recreation Master Plan updates and recommendations - File No.: 3-04-26) (B/L 145-2026)
4. A by-law to require the conveyance of land for park or other public recreational purposes within the City of St. Thomas, or the payment of money in lieu of such conveyance (Parkland Dedication By-law - City Initiated) (B/L 146-2026)
5. A by-law to assume Municipal Services in respect of Registered Plans between 1998 and 2026. (Subdivision Assumptions) (B/L 147-2026)
6. A by-law to authorize the Mayor and Clerk to execute and affix the Seal of the Corporation to a certain amending agreement between the Corporation of the City of St. Thomas and Vianode Canada Inc. (Land Lease - Yarmouth Yards) (B/L 148-2026) (A/G 66-2026)
Carried.

Carried.
